{"implementation":{"code":"def summarize_evaluations(job_description: str, evaluations: list[dict]) -> str:
    qualified_candidates = [ev for ev in evaluations if ev['qualified']]
    unqualified_candidates = [ev for ev in evaluations if not ev['qualified']]

    ranked_candidates = sorted(qualified_candidates, key=lambda x: x['score'], reverse=True)
    top_candidate = ranked_candidates[0] if ranked_candidates else None

    summary_lines = [f"Job Description: {job_description}", "", "Ranked Candidates:"]
    for candidate in ranked_candidates:
        summary_lines.append(f"- {candidate['name']} (Score: {candidate['score']}/10)")

    if top_candidate:
        summary_lines.append(f"\nTop Candidate: {top_candidate['name']}, Score: {top_candidate['score']}/10")

    # Concerns regarding unqualified candidates
    if unqualified_candidates:
        concerns = [f"- {uc['name']}: {uc['weaknesses']}" for uc in unqualified_candidates]
        summary_lines.append("\nConcerns for Unqualified Candidates:")
        summary_lines.extend(concerns)

    return '\n'.join(summary_lines)"},"compact":"none"}
